body:
Full Picture: S20 (MySQL+MongoDB queryability) DONE — signalapi endpoints live. S21-01+02 (Ask Emily chat) DONE. S23-00+06 (EDIS scaffold + Digital Immune System) DONE. S24-00 (nginx/systemd/docker-compose/deploy.sh scaffold) DONE. Stack is built; what's missing is (a) a server, (b) Ask Emily answers from real data, (c) subscription gate.

Critical path to first paying Emily+ subscriber: Server → Deploy (fatbaby.io live) → Signal context in Ask Emily → Rate limiting + auth → WooCommerce gate.

TOP 3 HIGHEST-LEVERAGE ITEMS:

1. PROVISION PRODUCTION SERVER [human action, infrastructure gate]
S23-01 and S24-01 both require a server that does not yet exist. Nothing ships without this. Recommend Hetzner CX32 (4 vCPU, 8GB RAM, ~€10/mo) or DigitalOcean 4GB droplet. All ops artifacts are ready: deploy.sh, nginx configs, systemd units, docker-compose.prod.yml, env.production template. One 'bash ops/deploy.sh' gets the Go backend live. One WordPress install with EDIS plugins gets the public face live. This is the single critical path gate blocking S23 and S24 entirely.

2. S21-03: WIRE FATBABY SIGNALS INTO ASK EMILY CONTEXT [code, start now, no server needed]
Currently POST /api/ask proxies raw questions to Emily Prime with no FatBaby data. Emily answers from training data alone — not defensible as a premium product. Fix: detect ticker in question, fetch entity doc + governance_signals from signalapi (S20-05 works), prepend as context to Emily Prime message. Transforms Ask Emily from generic chatbot into data-driven governance intelligence. This is what justifies $29/month. Dependencies: S20-05 ✓, S21-01 ✓. Implement in newssite ask handler. High leverage, low risk, can ship before server is provisioned.

3. S24-01 + S23-01: FIRST PRODUCTION DEPLOY — THE FLIP [ops, post-server]
Once server exists: run deploy.sh, start MySQL+MongoDB via docker-compose, install nginx + certbot SSL, verify /healthz. Then: WordPress install, activate edis-core/edis-signals/edis-ask-emily + edis theme, set EDIS_SIGNALAPI_URL + EDIS_EMILY_URL in wp-config, confirm /ticker/AAPL shows live governance signals and Ask Emily returns real answers. Emily Prime should own the deploy checklist, poll /healthz after each step, post Apple on completion. This single step takes both S23 and S24 from 'scaffold' to 'live product.'

NOT on the critical path right now: S23-02 (Yoast SEO — post-launch), S23-04 (WooCommerce subscription — needs live site first), S24-05 (load test — post-launch baseline), S24-03 (log rotation — good hygiene, not launch blocker).

HEIMDAL SPRINTS FILED: S21-03 (code sprint), Provision Server (infra sprint), First Deploy (ops sprint). See BACKLOG.md S23+S24 for full item list.
title: EDIS+OPS SYNTHESIS: 3 highest-leverage items — server provision, S21-03 signal context, first deploy [2026-06-13]
